description: Configurable cancellation rules for Vedic marriage matching. Rules are disabled by default if UNVERIFIED until verified by a consulting astrologer.

NADI_SAME_RASHI_DIFF_NAKSHATRA.name: Same Rashi, Different Nakshatras
NADI_SAME_RASHI_DIFF_NAKSHATRA.description: Exemption claimed when both partners share the same Moon sign but have different birth stars.

NADI_SAME_NAKSHATRA_DIFF_RASHI.name: Same Nakshatra, Different Rashis
NADI_SAME_NAKSHATRA_DIFF_RASHI.description: Exemption claimed when birth star spans across two distinct zodiac signs.

NADI_EXEMPT_NAKSHATRAS.name: Classically Exempt Nakshatras
NADI_EXEMPT_NAKSHATRAS.description: Tradition claiming Rohini, Mrigashira, Ardra, Punarvasu, Pushya, Shravana, Dhanishta, Shatabhisha, Uttara Bhadrapada are exempt.

NADI_DIFF_PADA_SAME_NAKSHATRA.name: Different Padas in Same Nakshatra
NADI_DIFF_PADA_SAME_NAKSHATRA.description: Exemption claimed when both partners share same star but different quarter divisions.

NADI_IDENTICAL_MOON_LORDS.name: Identical Moon Sign Lords
NADI_IDENTICAL_MOON_LORDS.description: Exemption claimed when both signs are ruled by the same planetary lord.

BHAKOOT_SAME_LORD.name: Same Rashi Lord
BHAKOOT_SAME_LORD.description: Exemption for 6/8 or 2/12 when signs share the same planetary ruler (Aries-Scorpio, Taurus-Libra, Capricorn-Aquarius).

BHAKOOT_FRIENDLY_LORDS.name: Mutual Friendship of Rashi Lords
BHAKOOT_FRIENDLY_LORDS.description: Exemption claimed when planetary lords of both Moon signs are natural mutual friends.

BHAKOOT_NAVAMSA_FRIENDSHIP.name: Navamsa Lord Friendship
BHAKOOT_NAVAMSA_FRIENDSHIP.description: Exemption claimed when Navamsa dispositors of Moon are mutual friends.

BHAKOOT_STRONG_NADI_MAITRI.name: Full Nadi and Graha Maitri Support
BHAKOOT_STRONG_NADI_MAITRI.description: Exemption claimed when Nadi score is 8/8 and Graha Maitri score is 5/5.

RASI_PORUTHAM_FRIENDLY_LORDS_MITIGATION.name: Rasi Porutham Mitigation by Friendly/Identical Lords
RASI_PORUTHAM_FRIENDLY_LORDS_MITIGATION.description: Exemption claiming inauspicious dispositions (6/8, 9/5, 2/12) are mitigated when Moon sign lords are friendly or identical.

MANGAL_ARIES_1ST.name: Mars in Aries in 1st House
MANGAL_ARIES_1ST.description: Mars in own sign Aries in Lagna.

MANGAL_CANCER_8TH.name: Mars in Cancer in 8th House
MANGAL_CANCER_8TH.description: Mars in debilitation sign Cancer in 8th house.

MANGAL_SCORPIO_7TH.name: Mars in Scorpio in 7th House
MANGAL_SCORPIO_7TH.description: Mars in own sign Scorpio in 7th house.

MANGAL_CAPRICORN_7TH_8TH.name: Mars Exalted in Capricorn in 7th/8th House
MANGAL_CAPRICORN_7TH_8TH.description: Mars exalted in Capricorn in 7th or 8th house.

MANGAL_PISCES_7TH_8TH.name: Mars in Pisces in 7th/8th House
MANGAL_PISCES_7TH_8TH.description: Mars in Pisces in 7th or 8th house.

MANGAL_JUPITER_CONJUNCTION.name: Guru-Mangala Conjunction
MANGAL_JUPITER_CONJUNCTION.description: Mars conjunct Jupiter in the same zodiac sign.

MANGAL_JUPITER_ASPECT.name: Jupiter Aspect on Mars (5th, 7th, 9th Drishti)
MANGAL_JUPITER_ASPECT.description: Jupiter casting 5th, 7th, or 9th house aspect on Mars.

MANGAL_MOON_CONJUNCTION.name: Chandra-Mangala Conjunction
MANGAL_MOON_CONJUNCTION.description: Mars conjunct Moon in the same zodiac sign.
